exclusion_reason: Implemented but red because the environmental reverb (EAX) send and its frozen wet/dry tolerance, and the binding of the 3D gain onto the DirectSound3DBuffer and XAudio2 emitter/listener COM surfaces, are not wired — so the positional-and-reverb fixture cannot mix its reverb band. The positional core exists generically in lib/audio.mjs on top of the BPTK-014 mixer: the DS3D inverse-distance attenuation (unity inside the minimum distance, inverse rolloff between min and max, held at the max-distance gain beyond it), the azimuth pan from one listener and one emitter over the left-handed right axis, and compute3dSourceGain combining attenuation and the constant-power pan into the same explicit left/right linear gain the mixer already consumes (plus the distance for a reverb send or Doppler ratio).
promotion_trigger: Promote when the positional and reverb fixture mixes within the frozen tolerance with zero underrun.
expected_failing_assertion: The EAX reverb send and the DirectSound3D/XAudio2 emitter-listener binding are absent, so the reverb band of the fixture is not mixed.
active_gate_evidence: Three tests prove the positional core: the distance attenuation follows the DS3D inverse-distance rolloff at its declared points, the azimuth pan places an emitter left/right/centered relative to the listener orientation, and the 3D source gain combines attenuation and the constant-power pan so a nearer emitter is louder and a right emitter is louder on the right; the existing offline mix stays underrun-free and the full suite stays green.
procedure: Run the submix, voice-ramp, geometry, and reverb fixture.
Compare the mix against the reference within the frozen tolerance.
Measure underrun over the sustained fixture.
